ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the upper-left box of the figure is written “building a reservoir”; it points to box I through a horizontal arrow; box I then points to box II through a horizontal arrow. In the figure, “building a reservoir” also points to box III through a downward arrow, and box III then points to “precipitation around the lake increases” in the lower middle. “Precipitation around the lake increases” also points respectively to box II and box IV, and box II also points downward to box IV. Then reason: The question asks about the content corresponding to box I. Box I is the direct change in a natural element produced along the upper path after “building a reservoir”, and it can further cause box II. After building a reservoir, the moisture conditions in and around the reservoir area improve, which will first cause the soil water content in the surrounding area to increase; increased soil moisture is also beneficial to increasing vegetation coverage. Therefore, box I should be “soil water increases”.
